# Kristina Bardysheva — UX/UI & Product Designer for Mobile Apps

> Warsaw-based UX/UI and product designer with 10+ years of experience designing mobile apps (iOS and Android): app UI, App Store screenshots and ASO, visual identity, motion and AI-powered photo apps. Available for B2B and full-time employment in the EU.

## Summary
- Role: UX/UI & Product Designer (mobile apps); Senior Graphic Designer at Appify (2023–present)
- Previous: Senior Graphic Designer at Apalon, Warsaw (2020–2023); Web and Graphic Designer at Kino-mo, Minsk (2017–2020); Graphic Designer at Alraunak LTD, Minsk (2016–2017)
- Education: Bachelor in Media and Visual Design, European Humanities University, Vilnius
- Location: Warsaw, Poland
- Strengths: mobile app UI, product design, App Store/ASO conversion design, visual identity, motion, 3D, AI-assisted image products
- Tools: Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, InDesign, Lightroom, Cinema 4D, Octane Render, Midjourney, ChatGPT, Claude, Adobe Firefly
